I rent this small maize plot here in the North East, and the rains are short so I must plan carefully. I will try to buy a little NPK and urea if the subsidy reaches our village, but money is tight so I cannot afford much — maybe one bag to spread on the whole plot. I keep a few goats so I will carry their droppings to the field before planting. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year, so I will plant the grains I saved from last harvest, and my children and I will do most of the weeding ourselves; I will only hire two or three people for the first weeding if the grass is too much.
